name: app-earthy-coral-green-cream-ui-screen-wall
title: Coral, Forest and Cream UI Screen Wall
whatItIs: A pale grey wall of tiled phone screens in coral, forest green and cream: a rotated 'HAHO' title card, a business card stack with a line chart, a month calendar, weather cards, a cart summary and product and profile screens.
whatItMeans: A tight three-colour palette makes many different screens feel like one family, and rotated type adds a graphic jolt.
techniques: Rotated big type inside a card
Tiling many phones into a dense grid

vocabulary.definition: Many app screens tiled together as a poster.
Text turned 90 degrees inside a layout.
A design limited to three main hues.
